Subject: Recap & next steps: Redwood discovery call - procurement & pricing path

Hi Samantha / Tom,

Thanks for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we keep momentum toward procurement: 

Call highlights:
- ACME is building an intelligent search assistant for customer support; peak inference is ~200 qps for embeddings/short text gen during business hours, lower off-hours.
- Data residency: production logs stay in ACME VPC, model requests contain no PII; however, legal wants clarity on data handling for hosted API.
- Procurement preferences: Tom mentioned budget owner leans toward PO for larger contracts but initial pilot could be on card if under $10k.
- Marketplace interest: procurement asked whether Redwood is available via their cloud marketplace (AWS Marketplace).

Suggested commercial path:
- Short pilot (30–60 days) on hosted API (on-demand or small commit) to validate latency/cost.
- If ACME needs isolation or predictable throughput, propose Dedicated (reserved capacity) with monthly commit.
- For fully regulated customers, Private (VPC/on-prem) is an option but typically later in the buying cycle.

Immediate next steps:
1) Dev / Solutions: can you produce a short cost estimate for: hosted on-demand pilot vs 3-month hosted commit vs a small Dedicated baseline? Please include PO vs card implications. (Dev / Jonas)
2) Marissa: I’ll share a one-page MAD (minimum action plan) for procurement and a rough proposal/attachments.
3) Samantha/Tom: can you confirm who in procurement and legal I should loop in and whether AWS Marketplace would simplify procurement on your side?

Attachments: 20260224-ACME-MAP.pdf (one-pager with mutual action plan) attached.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,

Marissa — thanks for the clear summary. A few clarifications from procurement/legal side: 

- Procurement: our standard is PO for any commitment > $10k. For pilots under that threshold we prefer corporate card. They asked if Redwood can accept PO + net30 terms for a pilot if we decide to commit.
- Marketplace: yes — AWS Marketplace listing makes contracting much simpler for our procurement team (they can process via marketplace subscription). Do you have a listing or an estimated timeline?
- Security/controls: legal needs a short note on data retention and logging (we’ll share a questionnaire later). For now, confirmation that request logs stored by Redwood are retained for X days and that we can set retention or disable logging for specific customers would be helpful.

Counter-proposal for next steps:
- If you can share a simple two-line SOW + ballpark numbers for hosted pilot vs hosted commit, we can get procurement to review and confirm PO eligibility.
- We can schedule a 30-min procurement/IT call next week if you provide a draft SOW for them to review ahead of time.

Marissa / team — quick notes and a recommended commercial path based on ACME’s needs: 

- Security/data retention: Redwood hosted (SaaS) retains request logs for 30 days by default; we can configure per-customer retention down to 0 days (no logs) or extend up to 90 days with an enterprise add-on. We can also offer an isolated dedicated deployment (Dedicated) for customers that require tenant separation of logs.

- Pricing sketches (ballpark; to be formalized):
  * Hosted on-demand pilot: metered usage; estimate $2,500–$6,000/month depending on traffic profile (embeddings + short gen). Payment: card preferred for quick pilots; procurement can later convert to PO if commit >= $10k.
  * Hosted 3-month commit (discounted): baseline commit $9k/month (3-month) with overage at on-demand rates; acceptable for procurement/net30 after contracting.
  * Dedicated baseline: reserved GPU pool (small) starting ~$25k/month — suitable if ACME needs isolation and predictable latency. Typically requires 6–12 week lead time for capacity planning and a monthly commit.

- Marketplace: Redwood is listed on AWS Marketplace (private SaaS listing). We can provide procurement with a marketplace SKU to simplify purchase; timelines: approval and listing details vary but we can provide a marketplace procurement link within 48 hours.

Action items I can own: produce a short pricing comparison (attached spreadsheet) and a 1-page SOW draft for a hosted pilot that supports PO/net30 if they sign for the commit. Attaching: Redwood-Proposal-Hosted-vs-Dedicated.xlsx (pricing sketch).

—Dev
